note: Separated from r2-criteria.json to keep the criteria file immutable (red-team fh-20260807-096 process defect). Text-code consistency only, no behavior change; R2-B results were produced by the fp-agnostic code.

content.change: Drop fp from annual-fact selection entirely. Annual facts are identified by form in (10-K,10-K/A) PLUS duration (end-start) in [300,400] days; fp is NOT used. Rationale (red-team measurement): SEC tags some ANNUAL income facts fp=Q4 (not FY) on the original filing, and the fp=FY-tagged version sometimes appears only in a LATER filing - so an fp=FY filter silently skips the original and prefers a later restatement (a PIT hazard, 0.2% of firm-periods = 18/7665 across 13 firms). Duration+form is what actually identifies an annual fact; fp adds nothing and sometimes subtracts the original.
content.executed_consistency: VERIFIED the R1/R2 code (annualDuration) never enforced fp (grep: no .fp reference in r1-forecast.mjs or r2-gls-icc.mjs). Therefore ALL executed runs (R1 gate, R2-B GLS-ICC committed 17722e0266) already used the fp-agnostic (safe) selection - this amendment aligns the criteria TEXT with what was executed; NO re-run is required and NO result changes. This closes the restatement-preference hazard.
